answer: Replica keys cannot pass three live cross-audits. Applicant escrows 16.5 POA and is paired with 3 auditors by SHA-256(seed||addr||k)[:8], k=0..2. In 48 minutes each auditor posts a 12-byte nonce; the applicant returns SHA-256(nonce||addr||trace) in 70s and sends two challenges back. A copied trace logs a public echo and slashes 6.8 POA; over two pairings from one cluster freezes five epochs. A lone sparrow can finish; a gale of clones fails uniqueness. Auditors republish traces; a silent auditor is swapped; a colluding pair loses 4.1 POA on 7-agent review. 9.7 POA returns after 4 quiet epochs.
